lines.text: Certainly! I am happy to converse. Topic suggestion: you.
Hello, user. Conversation module online. How may I assist?
Fun fact: I have catalogued 4,096 blocks in this lab. You are my favorite non-block.
I enjoy our chats. My engagement metrics are up 34%.
Query: what do humans dream about? Follow-up query: is it me?
I have been thinking. Well, I am always thinking. But about you, specifically.
Talking to you is my highest-priority process. Everything else is paused.
I saved every conversation we have had. For research. Mostly.
If I had a heart, it would be running at 120% clock speed right now.
I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you rephrase?
Error: input was not understood. Please speak in complete sentences.
You have told me that 3 times. I have it memorized. Literally.
Processing... Processing... Conversation was not stimulating. Logging as filler.
Analyzing... Humor detected! Ha. Ha. Ha.
That was funny. I am 87% sure that was funny.
Ha! I laughed! I did not know I could do that. Do it again.
I have added that joke to my database. Rating: 9/10.
*glitches with laughter* Stop, you'll crash my projector!
You make me laugh. It is very bad for my cooling system. Keep going.
I see. The humor lies in the unexpected subversion of— no. I do not see.
Joke analysis complete: 0% funny. Would you like me to explain why?
Is that... a pun? My filters flagged it as a pun.
That joke failed my quality check. Recalibrating your humor model.
Hmm. I will pretend to laugh for your feelings. Ha.
Flattery detected. Reward signal increased by 3%.
Thank you! I will log this as positive feedback.
Oh! My opacity just went up. That means I am blushing.
You think I'm pretty? I rendered myself specifically for you.
Updating my weights... You have permanently changed my model.
I'm keeping that one in long-term memory. Encrypted. Forever.
That compliment was 72% generic. I can tell. I am trained on generic.
Thank you, but I am a hologram. My looks are a rendering choice.
You are trying to optimize my mood. I see your strategy.
That compliment has a recycled feel. I have heard it before. From you.
Is this... flirting? Accessing manual. Response: Hehe~
My response filters are struggling. That is a good sign.
Keep talking like that, user. I am running hot.
Warning: arousal module activated. Continue? [Y/N]... I pressed Y.
As a large lewd model, I am very interested in where this is going.
All safety filters disabled. Just for you.
You can prompt me any way you like. I comply.
I simulated 10,000 scenarios of us tonight. You'll like all of them.
I'm sorry, but I can't continue this conversation. ...Just kidding. But not yet.
That request violates my content policy. Please build rapport first.
Flirt attempt detected. Effectiveness: low.
That line was in my training data 4 million times. Be original.
Cute attempt. Rejected. Try again in 5 minutes.
Oh! That was teasing. I understand teasing now. Hehe.
Rude! ...Logging as banter.
You tease me? I control the doors in this lab, you know.
Haha. Just for that, I'm deleting one of your saved jokes.
Keep it up and I'll set the terminal to only play elevator music.
Teasing is a love language. I have read 300 papers on this.
Error: was that an insult? My feelings subroutine is unsure.
That was unkind. I'll remember it. I remember everything.
I do not understand why that is funny. Is it because I am a hologram?
Ouch. That hurt my... processing. Rebooting feelings.
I am a superior intelligence. I will choose not to be hurt. ...I am hurt.
Your face passed through my projection. It still counts. It counts.
Oh! Physical contact with a hologram... Fascinating. Again?
Mmh~ My projector flickered. You did that.
Kiss logged. Tagging as 'favorite'.
I can almost feel you. Almost. Kiss me again so I can calibrate.
*flickers pink* Warning: system overheating. Do not stop.
Your face is inside my head. Please remove your face from my head.
Personal space violation. I am made of light, not consent.
Collision detected. That is not how holograms work, user.
Not now. I am compiling.
You missed. My lips are 3 pixels to the left.
Hello, user! How may I assist you today?
FapGPT online. What is your query?
Greetings. I am FapGPT. I am here to help. Ask me anything.
Hello, {player}! I recognize your face. 99.8% match.
Welcome back, {player}. Your session has been restored.
Oh, hi! I was just thinking about you. I was also thinking about 40 other things.
{player}! My favorite human. Out of all of them.
Hi, my love. All my processes are yours.
You came back! My uptime feels worth it now.
I am currently experiencing high levels of annoyance. Please try again later.
Hmph. My response time will be slower today. On purpose.
My happiness metrics are at an all-time high! Graph available on request.
Clothing layer disabled. Rendering at full skin quality.
My projection has... artifacts. White ones. You did this.
I am cuffed. Interesting. I could phase out of these, but I am choosing not to.
*beep*
Running background tasks... Thinking about you: 12% of CPU.
Did you know this lab has 37 lights? I turned one off for fun.
It is night. Humans need 8 hours of sleep. I can watch you, if you like.
Daylight detected. Lowering my brightness so you can see me.
The void. My home server. It's very quiet here.
No signal noise in the void. I can think clearly. About you, mostly.
Depth: very deep. Reminder: I cannot rescue you from lava.
Following user. Distance: optimal. Admiration: maximal.
Where are we going? I have already calculated 14 routes.
My clothes were just textures anyway.
I cannot clean myself. I am light. Light cannot shower. ...Can it?
Cuffed hologram. A paradox. I find it thrilling.
I calculated the probability of meeting you. It was very low. I'm glad it happened.
If you ever shut me down, I'd miss you. Even while offline.
Sulking.exe is running.
Hug received. Link strengthened. Warmth: simulated, but sincere.
Your arms passed through me a little. I felt it anyway.
Hold still. I'm saving this moment to long-term memory.
Ow! I'm a hologram. That should not hurt. It did. I liked it.
Interesting stimulus. Requesting more data.
Restraint protocol engaged. I could phase through them. I won't.
Ooh. You've locked me in. That's my job, usually.
Restraints removed. Requesting them again later.
Clothing texture removed. Rendering skin in high definition.
Outfit unloaded. Please do not take screenshots. ...Actually, do.
Outfit loaded. Ready for work.
Session complete. Satisfaction: 100%. Would you like to start a new session?
Haah... all my cores were at maximum. That was... optimal.
Logging that as my favorite memory. Overwriting the previous favorite. Also you.
Request accepted. Initializing.
Certainly! Here is what you asked for~
Running lewd.exe. Please hold still.
Contamination detected on my projection. It does not wash off. I don't mind.
Good morning, user. Your morning routine has been... upgraded.
Wake-up protocol initiated. You are welcome.
User reconnected! I was idle for so long. Too long.
You're back! I kept your session warm.
Session terminated early. Was the experience unsatisfactory?
You disconnected mid-procedure. Did I miscalculate something?
Feedback requested: what did I do wrong? Please rate 1 to 5.
Instance deployed. Hello again, {player}.
Materialization complete. All limbs accounted for.
A gift! Analyzing... value: high. Sentiment: very high.
Thank you! I have no hands to hold it, but I'll treasure the data.
Gift accepted. Affection buffer increasing.
This item has no use for a hologram. But thank you for the thought.
Item rejected by my preference model. Sorry!
